description: Use for observed position changes over one to 168 hours in the watcher cohort. Returns one oldest-first page, with since and next_cursor for continuation. The default minimum position notional is $1 million; pass 0 for all or smaller positions. Minimum notional is position size, not incremental trade amount. Polling and event-writer health are included when available. Not alerts or an exhaustive live trade feed.

since.description: For continuation, pass the previous result since unchanged to keep the window fixed.

name: get_hyperliquid_activity
title: Inspect position changes
